Selected work

Two ongoing case studies, each rebuilt from research rather than assumption.

01

Amazon, reconsidered

UX research IA Visual design Design system

A ground-up UX redesign of the Amazon shopping app, run through the Double Diamond process — competitive research against Walmart, Target, and AliExpress, and three personas built from that research.

Where the friction was

Weak information architecture buried categories, cluttered homepage and PDP sections had no visual boundaries, and order history had no predictable home in the app.

Key decisions

Merged redundant carousels, added a category teaser row, moved order history into Cart as a toggle tab, and gave the PDP a sticky section tab bar.

System

Deep navy (#05082C) with action orange (#EC8000) for the primary CTA, a warm cream base (#FCFAF6), and DM Sans across four weights.

Full case study write-up coming soon.

02

Ozoned Med Spa

UX research Mobile app Competitive analysis

A "Yelp for spas" concept for Ozoned Med Spa, a real medical spa in Baton Rouge and Mandeville — a discovery-and-booking app built around staff, reviews, and services.

Research followed the Double Diamond process: simulated interviews from App Store review mining, and competitive analysis of Vagaro, Fresha, and Mindbody.

What it does

Home surfaces services by category with pricing; Team lets clients pick a provider by rating and experience; booking narrows in three steps.

Early-stage screens — flows still evolving.

I came to design through people, not software.

My background is in psychology — an I/O focus — which is where my interest in product design started.

Before design: product management at Bodayga (cannabis marketplace), UX at Okala (e-commerce discovery), and talent acquisition at Snapp Group.

I work visually and directly — designing in Figma from the start rather than wireframing first.

Currently completing an MS in Digital Media Arts and Engineering at LSU, building toward UX roles in Europe — Germany and the Netherlands first.
